# Chinese New Year — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Chinese New Year associated with?", "Chinese, Lunar new year"),
    ("What is notable about Chinese New Year?", "Red envelopes, dragons"),
    ("What is context?", "Chinese, Lunar new year"),
    ("What is key fact?", "Red envelopes, dragons"),
    ("What is meaning?", "Largest human migration yearly"),
]

        print("Correct.")
